newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher on public funds buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher on public funds buying.

text.p: Tokyo stocks gained ground by the end of the Thursday session, encouraged by a wide range of buying from public funds, brokers said.
They said, however, institutional investors in general were still cautious, limiting further gains.
The key 225-issue Nikkei average closed up 177.95 points or 0.88 percent at 20,379.82. Its September futures added 220 points to 20,410.
"Buying from public funds kicked in, through Japanese financial institutions," said one broker at a Japanese securities house.
